newsitem.title: UK: Northern Electric to cut prices from Oct 1.
newsitem.headline: Northern Electric to cut prices from Oct 1.

text.p: Northern Electric Plc said on Thursday that it is to reduce prices to domestic customers from October 1, which will cut the average annual domestic electricity bill by about 17 stg, including VAT.

The company is also introducing a new tariff structure for domestic customers, including a Small Users Tariff from January 1997 to benefit customers who use less than the average amount of electricity.
Northern will offer a prompt payment discount from January of one stg per quarter off the normal standing charge when customers pay their previous quarterly bill on time.
From April next year Northern will increase its discount on bills paid by direct debit to three percent of the annual bill from one percent.
